mapper.select: SELECT id, pack_code, pack_version, pack_name, industry, tags, rule_codes, rule_snapshots, previous_version, description, author, download_count, rating, enabled, official, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM pmis_rule_pack WHERE pack_code = #{packCode} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, pack_code, pack_version, pack_name, industry, tags, rule_codes, rule_snapshots, previous_version, description, author, download_count, rating, enabled, official, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM pmis_rule_pack WHERE pack_code = #{packCode} AND pack_version = #{packVersion} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, pack_code, pack_version, pack_name, industry, tags, rule_codes, rule_snapshots, previous_version, description, author, download_count, rating, enabled, official, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM pmis_rule_pack WHERE industry = #{industry} AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY official DESC, download_count DESC
